'''Devil serpents''' were gigantic eels indigenous to the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They could shoot laser beams from their antennae. [[Orcon/Legends|Orcon]] used one such creature as a mount.<ref name="Ewoks 9" />
